svg.text: Terminal states are final. Only the reconciliation job may move PENDING_RECONCILIATION forward.
The job resolves to COMPLETED or FAILED.
An admin resolves MANUAL_REVIEW with an audited reason.
A callback or re-query that says SUCCESS after EXPIRED still
credits the wallet once (same reference) and the row moves to
Both machines are enforced in code with an allowed-transition table and a unit test per illegal move. Each transition writes an audit row.
Part 10 · System diagrams · Mulungushi University, Zambia
